scope: Native family, Q13, Q11 portable scientific entry points
transformations: Removed project-root paths, campaign gates, host locks, execution deadlines and approval workflows.

Preserved native processor/scorer, complete label plus terminator, historical substring diagnostic, exact IDEFICS2 token-prefix handling, official CLIP routing and same-storage aliases, GPTNeoX integer position compatibility, Q13 targets/optimizer/loss, VQA normalization and exact Q11 query-chunk attention.
Portable orchestration consumes frozen schedules. Explicit model directories are checked against recorded file hashes and native Transformers versions.

Q13 seeding occurs before native model construction; displayed-option candidate order and the mixed schedule are retained. Frozen-base hashes and fresh checkpoint reload are validated. Checkpoint evaluation rejects wrong model/arm/seed/source task, incomplete or modified fits, and smoke fits outside explicit smoke evaluation; Q13 source metadata are hash-bound by its completion receipt.

Q11 reconstructs frozen rule scenes and acquires pinned VQA/retention images using source IDs and byte hashes. VQAv2 uses the datasets Image decoder on the recorded parquet image column; no new query selection occurs.

Unified native classification generation parsing with the main normalized whole-label grammar. Case/punctuation-sensitive exact-format compliance remains a distinct diagnostic. All 6,480 saved family and replication records are released with complete candidate token log probabilities; the CPU reducer reconstructs all 36 published cells, image intervals and fitted/context-seed contrasts before attaching the new diagnostics.

validation.limitations: CPU checks and input reconstruction do not establish complete native model execution parity on a new backend. New fits may differ numerically across hardware.
